translations.python: IdealSolidSolution activity, concentration, standard-state, and partial-molar properties

behavioral_choices_and_limits: States are immutable Python values; upstream mutable ThermoPhase inheritance and cache machinery are not exposed.
Mole amounts are normalized and invalid finite-domain inputs raise ValueError.
The Phase::sum_xlogx mass-fraction implementation is represented by its algebraically identical sum(X_k log(X_k)) form.
Standard concentration supports the three source forms; solvent-volume means the final species is the solvent.
No Cantera, NumPy, SciPy, Cython, extension module, parser, or compiled solver is imported at runtime.
excluded_methods_and_features: ThermoPhase and Phase mutable state API, species insertion, units, serialization, YAML parsing, and factory registration
Full derivative APIs, electric potentials, phase dimensions, and multisite models
Transport, kinetics coupling, reactors, numerical integration, and non-ideal condensed phases

pressure corrections to h and g and pressure-independent u
ideal mixing entropy and g = h - T*s identity
